from manim import *


class NegativeProductScene(MovingCameraScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#f3ecd8"
        title = Text('Why two negatives make a positive', color="#241a12", font_size=34)
        title.move_to([0.0, 2.7, 0])
        formula = MathTex('(-2)(-3)=6', color="#241a12").scale(0.9)
        formula.move_to([0.0, 0.0, 0])
        target = Dot([0.0, -1.6, 0], radius=0.35, color="#b24c3d")
        decoys = VGroup(*[Dot(color="#4f766f").shift(RIGHT * ((i % 8) - 3.5) + DOWN * (1 + i // 8)) for i in range(2)])
        self.play(Write(title))
        self.play(FadeOut(title))
        self.play(Write(formula), FadeIn(target), FadeIn(decoys))
        self.play(self.camera.frame.animate.scale(0.8).move_to([0.0, -1.6, 0]))
        self.wait(1)
